title: AgentQueueJob
description: Mirrors apps/api/src/lib/agentQueue.ts's AgentQueueJob union by hand — the job payloads apps/api enqueues on the 'agent-jobs' BullMQ queue and apps/engine's Python consumer (agent/voice/consumer.py) picks up, distinguished by BullMQ's own job name ('agent-start' or 'cv-parse'). Session-lifecycle timing decisions (no-show, interview-timeout-finalize) moved to apps/api's own 'orchestrator-jobs' queue — see orchestrator-job.schema.json — since apps/api is now the sole decision-maker for session state; apps/engine only prepares interview content (CV parsing, question selection) on this queue now.

oneOf.title: AgentStartJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued for scheduledAt minus 2 minutes — the agent prepares the room. The candidate's CV is normally already parsed by a prior CvParseJob (Candidate.cvParsedJson); everything else the agent needs (role blueprint, question bank) it looks up from Postgres directly by these ids — see apps/engine/agent/db.py.

oneOf.title: CvParseJob
oneOf.description: Enqueued the moment a candidate is added, not tied to any interview — parses the CV into structured JSON (skills, experience, seniority) and saves it to Candidate.cvParsedJson, ahead of any interview being scheduled. Keeps the slow LLM call out of AgentStartJob's 2-minute lead time.
